properties.description: ST37 controlled master orchestration. Industry-refactor v1: thin orchestration, ADF concurrency=1 plus existing SQL active-run guard, stage-produced row-count metadata propagation, and metadata-driven reconciliation. Master owns batch lifecycle; children own detailed stage failures. FINAL V2: thin-master ownership. Child pipelines own detailed stage failure logging; Master owns batch close/fail. Native Master failures use PL_Common_Error_Handler. Upstream row counts are propagated to reconciliation without ADLS recounts. FINAL V4: removed invalid nested IfCondition; uses a top-level Switch router after Bronze metadata is cached in pipeline variables. FINAL V6: PipelineControl close calls now explicitly set DataLoadStatus and ErrorCode. Canonicalized ExecutePipeline parameters for PL_Common_Error_Handler; null-safe ParentRunId; resilient failure-handler dependency where applicable.

sqlReaderQuery.value: SELECT DB_NAME() AS DatabaseName, @@SERVERNAME AS ServerName, CAST(COUNT(*) AS INT) AS ActiveCount, CAST(CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS CanRun FROM control.PipelineControl WHERE PipelineName = 'PL_Master_Orchestrator_ST37_CONTROLLED' AND Status = 'RUNNING' AND RunStartTime >= DATEADD(MINUTE, -60, SYSUTCDATETIME())

text.value: @concat('UPDATE control.PipelineControl SET PipelineRunId = ''', pipeline().RunId, ''', WindowKey = ''', activity('PLST37_to_Bronze').output.pipelineReturnValue.WindowKey, ''', IsReplay = ', if(equals(toLower(pipeline().parameters.RunMode),'replay'),'1','0'), ', IsBackfill = ', if(equals(toLower(pipeline().parameters.RunMode),'backfill'),'1','0'), ' WHERE PipelineName = ''PL_Master_Orchestrator_ST37_CONTROLLED'' AND BatchId = ''', concat('BATCH_', formatDateTime(pipeline().TriggerTime,'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'), '_', substring(pipeline().RunId,0,8)), ''';')

text.value: @concat('DECLARE @FailedRowCount INT; SELECT @FailedRowCount = COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT WellID FROM gold.Dim_Well WHERE [Is_Current] = 1 GROUP BY WellID HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) x; INSERT INTO control.DataQualityResult (PipelineRunId, PipelineName, BatchId, WindowKey, DatasetName, RuleName, RuleResult, ExpectedValue, ActualValue, FailedRowCount, CheckTime) VALUES (''', pipeline().RunId, ''', ''PL_ST37_to_Bronze_INCREMENTAL'', ''', concat('BATCH_', formatDateTime(pipeline().TriggerTime,'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'), '_', substring(pipeline().RunId,0,8)), ''', ''', variables('v_WindowKey'), ''', ''Gold_Dim_Well'', ''GoldSingleCurrentRecord'', CASE WHEN @FailedRowCount = 0 THEN ''PASS'' ELSE ''FAIL'' END, ''0'', CAST(@FailedRowCount AS NVARCHAR(20)), @FailedRowCount, SYSUTCDATETIME()); IF @FailedRowCount > 0 BEGIN THROW 51001, ''Gold SCD2 DQ failed: duplicate Is_Current records detected.'', 1; END;')
